text_block_list.text:
A few days after running into
Matikanefukukitaru...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Heya! Can I borrow a minute of your time?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: I was thinking about starting my training for tryouts today—like, real training!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
It was revealed to me through my
horoscope that doing well at the
upcoming
tryouts is paramount to my success.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Which means that I'll be needing your
guidance! That's okay with you,
right?!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: But I'm not even your trainer yet!

text_block_list.text:
A TV psychic said to "lend your ear to the
experts." And you're an
expert trainer,
right?! So you gotta train me—you just
gotta!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару won't take no for an
answer, so I finally give in to
her request
to do some training with her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Are you serious?! My training is running in
a scrimmage?!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: You said you wanted "real training," right?

text_block_list.text: I mean, yeah... I did, but...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Thinking that the best way to improve is to
gain as much experience
as possible, as
quickly as possible, I've already organized
a
scrimmage for her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Howdy there! May the better runner win
the race!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: Whoa! I'm going against Taiki?!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Your trainer here came to me to ask if I
could lend a hand! It's the
least I can do as
your friend!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
But you're practically good enough to
make your debut! Trainer, I
can't race
against her!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: What happened to listening to the experts?

text_block_list.text: Aaargh! Ya got me there...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Could I at least try reading my fortune
first?!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Eko, eko, azure seal! Eko, eko, wall o' rust!
Goddess of victory, heed
my call!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
She chants some kind of mysterious
incantation, pulls a pencil out of
thin air
and rolls it on the ground.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Great fortunes await me at the end
of this race!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: It's decided! I will run in this scrimmage! Witness me fly faster than I've ever flown before!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Ya ready, Taiki?!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
You betcha! I'm locked and loaded! Let's
have a little fun, why don't
we?!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
And so begins the scrimmage between
Matikanefukukitaru and Taiki
Shuttle.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... pant...
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
Wow... Taiki really is something. I'd better
pick up the pace!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I won't lose though! After all, fortune
stands by my side today!
Forward—to a
glorious future of luck aplenty!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: I lost?! But how?!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: I guess you ran out of luck.

text_block_list.text: Hrnnng... That's not it at all!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I need to funnel this frustration into
motivation! That's what my great
fortune
is—I'm sure of it!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I need to book it! The next race
isn't gonna win itself!
Uwaaah!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Hey, are we done already?! But I wanted
to run with ya some more!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
That night, right as I'm leaving the
academy campus, I hear a strange
voice.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Woiya... Haiya... Reveal tonight's lucky
track to mine eye!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, it's you.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Well, I want to go running, but I first need
to figure out the best track
to run on!
Nothing a little bit of divination can't
solve!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
The great Shiraoki would be displeased if I
ever attempted to rely on
luck alone!
Good fortune blesses those who work for
it!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Shiraoki is this amazing goddess who
appears in my dreams! She tells
me what's
lucky and leads me along a path of great
fortune!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
If I'm ever feeling lost, down, or anxious,
she cheers me up—makes
me feel better!
She even helped me during my scrimmage
with Taiki!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
The reason why I'm even here right now is
all thanks to the great
Shiraoki! I chose to
believe in her, and that brought me to
where I am
today...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: A benevolent and irreplaceable goddess, huh?

text_block_list.text:
Spot on! Now you're getting it! She's
amazing, isn't she?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
In any case, I need to get back to training!
I'm off to the lucky track!
Super Fortune
Daaaash!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Wait, what?! Why is there a puddle here?!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
These divinations seem to serve as some
kind of motivation for her to
fulfill her own
desire to run.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару is definitely an
Umamusume of many quirks, but I
feel like
I'm beginning to see who she really is
behind her shell of
fortune.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
